name: Polygon Rasterization (2D)
definition: A 2D scan-line algorithm to rasterize a polygon into a P-buffer by decomposing it into triangles and flipping presence bits for covered positions.
summary: Polygon Rasterization (2D) converts 2D polygons into a presence buffer for 3D voxelization by decomposing shapes into triangles and using bit-flip parity to determine voxel inclusion.
